meta.title: SkyEagle – Aviation, Aerospace & Aircraft Maintenance Platform
meta.description: SkyEagle: knowledge, learning, careers, community and a store dedicated to aviation and aerospace engineering.

hero.title: Soar toward higher knowledge
hero.subtitle: One integrated platform for knowledge, learning, careers, community and a store, all focused on aviation and aerospace engineering.

sections.title: Platform sections
sections.subtitle: Everything you need for your journey in aviation and space, in one place.

aviation.title: Aviation Engineering
aviation.desc: Fundamentals of aerodynamics, propulsion, structures and aircraft systems.

space.title: Space Engineering
space.desc: Rockets, satellites, orbits and space exploration technologies.

maintenance.title: Aircraft Maintenance & Repair
maintenance.desc: Maintenance, inspection and repair concepts, plus quality and safety systems.

library.title: Articles & References
library.desc: Articles, educational books and engineering references you can search and save.

jobs.title: Jobs & Training
jobs.desc: Career and training opportunities in aviation for those starting out or moving up.

courses.title: Courses
courses.desc: Free and paid courses with progress tracking, quizzes and completion certificates.

community.title: Community & Discussions
community.desc: A space for discussion and sharing experience among students, engineers and enthusiasts.

store.title: Online Store
store.desc: Books, references, engineering files, digital products and aviation merchandise.

about.title: About Us
about.desc: Learn about SkyEagle's mission, its team and how to reach us.

platform.title: More than an information site
platform.subtitle: A scalable platform that grows with its community.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.desc: Organized content, fast search and saved favorites.

learning.title: Learning
learning.desc: Courses, quizzes and completion certificates under clear conditions.

careers.title: Careers
careers.desc: Connecting job and training seekers with aviation opportunities.

community.title: Connection
community.desc: Personal profiles, discussions, comments and shared expertise.

commerce.title: Commerce
